_comment: CockroachDB Cloud Managed MCP Server — how the analyst reads memory in production.
Read-only by default and audited on the CockroachDB side, which is the whole point:
the model can recall memory but is structurally incapable of writing to the memory
it is reasoning over. The local equivalent is the mnemos_analyst_ro role created in
packages/memory/migrations/002_roles.sql, so dev and cloud have identical posture.
Auth is OAuth against the CockroachDB Cloud session — there is no secret in this file.
The cluster id is an identifier, not a credential.
